data.case_title: Invoice from Glaserei Beispielscheibe for window repair
data.explanation: This is an invoice from the glazier for replacing a damaged window pane and an emergency glazing job. You need to pay the total amount by the deadline shown, which is calculated from the invoice date. If you don't pay in time, the glazier may send a reminder and could add late fees. Keep this invoice: the labor portion of craftsman work done in your home (Handwerkerleistungen) can often be claimed as a tax reduction on your German tax return, so it may be worth mentioning to a tax advisor or including when filing.
